design_system_injection.custom_css: :root { --bg: #120817; --surface: #20102A; --surface-alt: #2A1736; --text: #FFF1FF; --muted: #D8C0DC; --primary: #C084FC; --accent: #FACC15; --on-primary: #000000; --on-accent: #000000; --border: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 14%, transparent); --grid-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 8%, transparent); --radius: 18px; --gap: 32px; --blur: 12px; --nav-position: sticky; --shadow: 0 24px 70px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 13%, transparent); --shadow-strong: 0 36px 100px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 20%, transparent); } body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; } h1,h2,h3,.display { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; } .emergency-dock { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 18px; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 60; display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 90%, transparent); border: 1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur)); } .emergency-dock .cta-primary { min-height: 48px; }  @media (max-width: 760px) { .hero, .hero--bento, .local-map-panel, .editorial-flow { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: auto; } .proof-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
